sources.quote: Summarizes Jacquesson's phonology (pp.23-94): (C)V(C) syllable, two stop series, five oral + five nasal vowels, a relic high (glottalized) vs modal register opposition in ~30 pairs for some speakers; says nothing about word stress/accent placement.
